programme.title: Roothe Sujan Maniye
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's Doha "Roothe Sujan Maniye" where he says, if your family or friends are offended, you should try your best to convince & win them back not just once but multiple times.

programme.title: Rahiman Nij Sampatti
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Nij Sampatti" where he uses the metaphor of a blooming lotus in a pond to prove that only your hard work, calibre & effort can get you through challenges.

programme.title: Pharzi Sah
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's Doha "Pharzi Sah" where he says, if one tries to achieve something through immoral ways he would fail in doing so, therefore always be kind & righteous in your ways.

programme.title: Bhaar Jhoki Ke
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Bhaar Jhoki Ke" where he says, ego is one of the heaviest weights that a person carries on himself & this weight of ego can lead to drowning in toxicity.

programme.title: Rahiman Muskil Aa
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Muskil Aa" where he says, life is about choosing between truth which would lead to desertion by the world or falsehood which would lead to desertion by God.

programme.title: Rahiman Vipda
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Vipda" where he says, sometimes short-term calamities or challenges in life are necessary as during these times we get to know our real well-wishers.

programme.title: Rahiman Chup Hwey
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Chup Hwey" where he says, when bad days come one should sit quietly because when good days come, it does not take long to make a point.

programme.title: Taruvar Phal Nahi
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Taruvar Phal Nahi" where he says, trees do not eat their own fruits, similarly good and gentlemen are those who accumulate wealth for the work of others.

programme.title: Khwaab
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the importance of dreaming. He says you may dream to have a good life, a successful career, a family, a house, etc. but a dream results in success only when put to action.

programme.title: Parindey
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar talks about birds being used as a metaphor to represent humans. The expression of birds flying in the sky is generally used to symbolise success, ambitions, carefreeness, prosperity & abundance.

programme.title: Urdu / Sarsari
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says shayars earlier had a good control on their speech, dialect, pronunciations & we must incorporate this quality in our speaking to make it more effective.

programme.title: Baat
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says it is extremely important to have a nice talk.

programme.title: Lafz
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says words are not just those included in dictionaries but more than that. He says words should be mindfully uttered especially during fights, as they can at times harm relationships.

programme.title: Dostee
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says in life we can't choose our relatives, but we can definitely choose our friends. He says the bond of friendship sometimes proves to be stronger than all our other bonds.

programme.title: Rahiman Dekhi
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Dekhi" where he says, do not forget the small things in life after seeing big ones, as everything whether big or small is useful in some or the other way.

programme.title: Roothe Sujan Maniye
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's Doha "Roothe Sujan Maniye" where he says, if your family or friends are offended, you should try your best to convince & win them back not just once but multiple times.

programme.title: Rahiman Nij Sampatti
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Nij Sampatti" where he uses the metaphor of a blooming lotus in a pond to prove that only your hard work, calibre & effort can get you through challenges.

programme.title: Pharzi Sah
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's Doha "Pharzi Sah" where he says, if one tries to achieve something through immoral ways he would fail in doing so, therefore always be kind & righteous in your ways.

programme.title: Bhaar Jhoki Ke
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Bhaar Jhoki Ke" where he says, ego is one of the heaviest weights that a person carries on himself & this weight of ego can lead to drowning in toxicity.

programme.title: Rahiman Muskil Aa
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Muskil Aa" where he says, life is about choosing between truth which would lead to desertion by the world or falsehood which would lead to desertion by God.

programme.title: Rahiman Vipda
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Vipda" where he says, sometimes short-term calamities or challenges in life are necessary as during these times we get to know our real well-wishers.

programme.title: Rahiman Chup Hwey
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Chup Hwey" where he says, when bad days come one should sit quietly because when good days come, it does not take long to make a point.

programme.title: Taruvar Phal Nahi
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Taruvar Phal Nahi" where he says, trees do not eat their own fruits, similarly good and gentlemen are those who accumulate wealth for the work of others.
